# Monitor debt covenants and lender reporting

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

While a company has a loan, venture-debt or credit agreement with reporting or performance conditions. A reviewed covenant calculation and reporting pack with actual or forecast breaches escalated before the next action.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Extract the operative obligations from signed agreements

agent-runnable


Create a register of covenant definitions, measurement periods, reporting dates, certificates and notice clauses. Record amendments and waivers with their effective dates rather than reusing an outdated term sheet.

- Sources: [SBA loans](https://www.sba.gov/loans/) · [IRS recordkeeping](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/recordkeeping)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Recompute tests from reconciled financial data

agent-runnable


Apply each agreement's definitions to the correct period and show the calculation inputs. Separate actual results from forecasts and identify add-backs or classifications that require lender or adviser confirmation.

- Sources: [SBA loans](https://www.sba.gov/loans/) · [IRS recordkeeping](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/recordkeeping)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Review headroom and potential noncompliance

human · human approval required


Finance leadership and counsel resolve interpretation questions and assess projected headroom. Route an actual default to the covenant-default response process instead of assuming a waiver or netting a breach against another metric.

- Sources: [SBA loans](https://www.sba.gov/loans/) · [IRS recordkeeping](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/recordkeeping)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Approve and deliver the required lender reports

human · human approval required


The designated signatory reviews the final certificate and attachments before delivery through the agreed channel. Retain the submitted version and evidence of receipt, with confidential materials access-controlled.

- Sources: [SBA loans](https://www.sba.gov/loans/) · [IRS recordkeeping](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/recordkeeping)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Track responses and the next measurement cycle

agent-runnable


Record questions, approvals and any signed waiver without treating silence as consent. Refresh the liquidity forecast and assign follow-up for conditions, remediation and upcoming reporting dates.

- Verify: A reviewed covenant calculation and reporting pack with actual or forecast breaches escalated before the next action.
- Sources: [SBA loans](https://www.sba.gov/loans/) · [IRS recordkeeping](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/recordkeeping)
